title: Human-centric Spatio-Temporal Video Grounding via the Combination of Mutual Matching Network and TubeDETR

problems.name: Spatio-Temporal and Object/Event-Level Grounding
problems.evidence_sentence: Given a sentence depicting an object, spatio-temporal video grounding (STVG) [11, 16] extracts the spatio-temporal tube of the object.

problems.name: Cross-Modal Semantic Alignment Gap
problems.evidence_sentence: Specifically, TubeDETR exploits a video-text encoder and a space-time decoder to predict the starting time, the ending time and the tube of the target person.

methods.name: Object/Event/Spatio-Temporal Modules
methods.evidence_sentence: Given a sentence depicting an object, spatio-temporal video grounding (STVG) [11, 16] extracts the spatio-temporal tube of the object.

methods.name: Transformer/DETR-Style Proposal Decoding
methods.evidence_sentence: Yu et al. [1] propose to extract human information from the query text, i.e., gender, clothing color and *Corresponding author. clothing type, generate human tubes from the corresponding video, and finally exploit a Transformer to encode visual and textual features to perform tube-description matching and tube trimming.
